value.name: Asha withholds the upstairs contents
value.description: Asha treats the rest of the papers as something hidden upstairs behind a lock she has been guarding all week.
evidence: the rest of it was upstairs behind a lock she had been guarding all week

value.name: Daniel demands an answer about Lucia
value.description: From below the stairs, Daniel asks Asha whether Lucia found anything real or is only guessing.
evidence: From the foot of the stairs Daniel's voice came up sharper than before, climbing two steps so his head cleared the half-landing: Asha, just tell me—did Lucia find anything real, or is she just guessing.

value.name: Asha conceals the key
value.description: Asha closes her hand around the key so it disappears against the folder, refusing to answer Daniel.
evidence: Asha closed her hand around the key so it disappeared inside her fist against the folder, and did not turn to answer him

value.name: Asha decides to go upstairs
value.description: The key in Asha's palm signals that she is going upstairs next without saying so aloud.
evidence: the small weight in Asha's palm settled the question of where she was going next without her having to say it on the stairs

value.name: Asha shields Lucia from Daniel
value.description: Asha shifts on the stair so her body blocks Lucia from Daniel's voice below.
evidence: Asha closed her hand tighter around the key until the tarnish bit warm against her palm, and shifted half a step on the tread so her shoulder came between Lucia and the open spindle of the railing where Daniel's voice was still climbing

value.name: Lucia silently directs Asha upstairs
value.description: Lucia backs up the last stairs while keeping eye contact with Asha and gestures toward the sewing room door.
evidence: Lucia took the cue without needing it spoken; she stepped backward up the last two stairs, her eyes not leaving Asha's, and tipped her chin once toward the sewing room door at the end of the short hall

value.name: Asha follows Lucia into the sewing room
value.description: Asha goes after Lucia, holding the folder against her ribs and still refusing to answer Daniel's question.
evidence: Asha followed, the folder pressed flat against her ribs so the codicil and the folded page rode together, and did not answer the question coming up from below

value.name: Lucia closes the sewing room door
value.description: Lucia waits for Asha to enter, then shuts the door behind them, cutting off Daniel's voice.
evidence: At the threshold Lucia waited for her to come fully inside before she set her hand on the door, and the small click of the latch behind them was quieter than Daniel's voice had been
